title: Childbirth preparation (evening series)
place: Birth Center classroom, Harlow Creek Medical Center
summary: Four Tuesday evenings covering labor, breathing, newborn care and a tour of the birth center.
registration: Call (555) 018-1700 or ask your obstetric clinic to register. Partners are welcome.
body: This four-week series is for patients in the second or third trimester and their support person. Week four includes a walking tour of labor and delivery.

title: Diabetes self-management workshop
place: Community education room, Ashford Family Clinic
summary: A Saturday morning workshop on blood sugar, medication, food and activity, led by a diabetes educator.
registration: Register by calling (555) 018-3100. Space is limited to 20 participants.
body: Bring a list of your medications. Fingerstick supplies are provided for practice during the class.

title: Community blood pressure screening
summary: Walk-up blood pressure checks and brief counseling. No appointment needed.
registration: Just show up. If your reading is high, we will help you find follow-up care.
body: Screenings are offered by nursing staff from Millhaven Urgent Care. This is not a full medical visit.

title: Cancer support group
summary: A facilitated group for adults in treatment or recovery, and for caregivers on alternating months.
registration: Email cancer.support@harlowcreek.example or ask your navigator. No registration fee.
body: Meetings are confidential. Virtual dial-in is available if you cannot come in person.

title: Stop-the-bleed community training
place: Emergency conference room, Harlow Creek Medical Center
summary: Hands-on training in bleeding control for the public, taught by trauma nurses.
body: You will practice packing a wound and applying a tourniquet on training equipment. Certificates are given at the end.

title: Joint replacement information night
summary: What to expect before, during and after hip or knee replacement, with time for questions.
registration: Call (555) 018-6100 to reserve a seat. Family members welcome.
body: Surgeons and therapists walk through the pathway used at Harlow Creek, including same-day or next-day discharge when appropriate.
